pages.title: Our Head of College | Dulwich College (Singapore)
blocks: It is my great pleasure to welcome you to Dulwich College (Singapore).

Dulwich College (Singapore) is an international school that embraces the ethos and values of British independent education. Rooted in the rich 400-year history of our founding school, Dulwich College in London, we blend tradition with forward-thinking innovation. Our global perspective mirrors the diverse backgrounds of our students, who come from all corners of the world.

We believe that students should always come first, and so they are placed at the heart of all decision-making. This foundational value shapes everything we do. By understanding each student as an individual, deliberately creating the opportunities which inspire them to discover their passions and overcome challenges, we equip them with the confidence and resilience needed to forge a future-ready path for themselves. If you venture a little further, you will see countless examples of how we put our 'students first’ philosophy into practice.

Our College is structured into three closely connected schools—DUCKS, Junior School and Senior School—each designed to offer world-class facilities and a learning environment that 'grows' alongside your child. The smaller school feel is key to our individualised learning approach, ensuring that the academic progress and wellbeing of every child is effectively supported.

But each of our three schools also benefits from being part of something bigger. We give our students plenty of room to grow outside of their own class. Through our state-of-the-art facilities, House system, extensive CCA programme and wide-ranging opportunities to explore the world together beyond the College campus, our students develop a strong sense of identity and build close connections forged by shared experiences.

Together, we are supporting our children to be the leaders of tomorrow. They leave us as Alleynians, global citizens equipped with a strong moral compass which will guide them in the next stage of a lifelong journey of fulfillment and happiness.
We will always put your children first—because we’re not just a school, we’re a family.
